open_pull_requests.body:
## P0.25a — Exact accepted odds in paper journal, independent WIN payout checks

**Dependency:** stacked on integrated research tree [PR #31](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/pull/31); no direct merge into main in this task.

### What changed
- `JournalEvent.RESERVE` now persists accepted synthetic paper selection `side` and decimal `odds` with stake/time. No receipt from a sportsbook is inferred.
- `replay_journal()` stores accepted reserve odds and side and rejects `SETTLE_WIN` unless `payout == stake × original accepted odds` in exact Decimal arithmetic.
- Open `PaperPosition` odds and side are reconciled against the original journal RESERVE, not silently trusted after edits.
- A manually constructed legacy RESERVE with **neither** accepted side nor odds can still replay LOSS/VOID for day/week counts. Such evidence is **insufficient for WIN** and for reconciling a currently open modern paper position. Partial/mutated/invalid reserve quote metadata and odds on settlement events fail closed.
- Docs and 11 synthetic focused tests; unchanged safety gates for source, model, odds T−60 and live allocation.

### TDD proof
- Initial RED [run #45328017310](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/actions/runs/45328017310), Ubuntu3.11: **8 failed, 325 passed**. Specifically: fake WIN `20` accepted despite `stake=10, odds=1.90` (correct payout `19`), missing accepted odds, forged position odds/side, nonfinite input.
- First GREEN [run #45328231777](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/actions/runs/45328231777), **4/4 PASS, 333 tests**.
- Additional RED [run #45328398514](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/actions/runs/45328398514), Ubuntu3.12: **2 failed, 333 passed** due to partial RESERVE quote metadata and side mutated to `C`. Fixed with paired side/odds validation.
- Final **[run #45328528639](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/actions/runs/45328528639), head `9c1596d330086dd44fa18344c3ff8dc0bf179d87`: 4/4 PASS** Windows/Ubuntu Python3.11/3.12; Ubuntu3.11 **335 passed**.

### Explicit remaining blockers
This verifies internal synthetic paper settlement math, **NOT** journal source authenticity or complete audited cash accounting. An attacker could rewrite a whole internally consistent journal without an independently pinned anchor. Missing audit events: externally authenticated opening balance, month-close cash reset/withdrawal, actual funding TOPUP, transfers/profit lock, full cash and annual-negative-month reconciliation. Separate P0.25b required. Genuine licensed T−60 prices, official ATP timestamp evidence, model edge/profit and all real-money execution remain unverified. **Do not close Issue #25 or merge into a live release on this basis alone.**

## P2B — Event-embargo Elo historical skill experiment, private noncommercial research

**Stacked dependency:** [Draft #27](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/pull/27) → [Draft #28](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/pull/28) → this PR. Do not merge directly to main or characterize CI from separate branches as integrated acceptance.

### Implementation
- Source-pinned, read-only local TML CSV inputs (YYYY.csv or SHA256-qualified immutable snapshots, 2021–25) and explicit per-file source hashes.
- Correct calendar-year holdouts for 2023/2024/2025, including a 2025-season source tournament that began December 2024.
- Stable player orientation independent of winner-first CSV ordering, Elo K=24, optional surface shrinkage 0.35, conservative fixed 28-day embargo on all outcomes in an event-start batch.
- One-day source tournament-date variations are grouped to the **earliest** date so matches in one event do not update each other's pre-tournament ratings. Multi-week conflicting event-date spread fails closed.
- Invalid score/retirement, unsupported levels, missing match identity, malformed source rows are excluded/quarantined with counts, not guessed. No actual match-start timestamps exist, so this remains a *retrospective conditional-matchup skill study*.
- Three chronological annual evaluation folds with Brier/logloss vs coinflip, descriptive event-cluster uncertainty and safe `HISTORICAL_SKILL_RESEARCH_ONLY` output; no market ROI, actual T−60, stake, allocation or live model certification.

### GitHub verification
- Prior CI [#45250911413](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/actions/runs/45250911413) found one faulty test expectation: 2024 fold count accidentally omitted the 2025 provider file's December-2024 tournament. **Fixed the fixture** to include the extra 2024 event; deliberately kept event-embargo algorithm unchanged.
- Final [Actions #45320197207](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/actions/runs/45320197207), head `20d6b5f99ed879cd1a4385b59a47d7ad5043534f`: **4/4 PASS** Windows/Ubuntu Python 3.11/3.12. Ubuntu Python 3.11 full suite **240 passed**.

### Independent public-source sanity calculation (NOT Python CLI acceptance)
[Issue #29 note](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/issues/29#issuecomment-7121222576) documents an independent JavaScript port run on exact TML GitHub `master` annual snapshot content (2021–2025, 14,668 source result rows), 7,194 retrospective holdout matchups. Aggregate **coinflip Brier 0.2500 / logloss 0.693147**, **overall Elo 0.220362 / 0.629734**, **surface-shrunk Elo 0.220550 / 0.630918**. Python CLI must still reproduce those values on pinned SHA256 files to claim model-study reproducibility; preliminary calculation has no market benchmark.

### Mandatory caveats
- Tournament start is *not* match start; matchup pairs are known retrospectively and not proved available pre-event.
- 28-day embargo is conservative but not exact event result-publication timestamp.
- No official draw-by-match independent certification, true bookmaker odds, T−60 quote receipts, external full-journal cash authenticity, trading market advantage or reliable profit.
- `market_edge_verified=false`, `model_validation_trusted=false`, `allocation_enabled=false`, `stake=0`.

**Disposition:** 4/4 CI passed on this branch; Draft awaiting independent code review, dependency-order integration and a real pinned Python CLI run.

## Stacked merge-tree acceptance (2026-11-24)
- Corrected PR base to `feat/p1-tml-versioned-updates` (#28), itself targeting `feat/p1-tml-noncommercial-2024-audit` (#27).
- Broad CI `pull_request: {}` now tests feature-base PRs; prior base-main-only CI was silently skipping stacked checks.
- **[GitHub Actions #45320977246](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/actions/runs/45320977246): 4/4 PASS** (Windows/Ubuntu × Python 3.11/3.12) on PR #30 merge tree with latest #28 base; Ubuntu Python 3.11 suite **244 passed**.
- This verifies code/test integration in that stacked PR environment, **not** a merged `main` build, not actual source CLI execution and not independent code review.

## P1.5 — Versioned TennisMyLife ATP research source updates (personal/noncommercial)

**Dependencies:** Stacked on [Draft PR #27](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/pull/27), which introduces the read-only TML February 2024 candidate audit. **Merge/review #27 first**, then rebase/retarget and independently review this PR. Do not merge directly to `main` while stacked.

### Why
User explicitly uses this project for **private noncommercial ML research** and wants free public-source updates. The [publisher's CSV database and official download commands](https://stats.tennismylife.org/tennis-match-database) permit personal/educational/noncommercial research. Do not redistribute vendor CSVs or infer unlimited commercial rights from a public URL.

### Production changes
- `src/atp_gate/tml_snapshot.py`: fixed HTTPS publisher URL `https://stats.tennismylife.org/data/{year}.csv`; 20 MiB hard cap; UTC-aware check, **minimum 24-hour check interval** by default, explicit `--force` override.
- Strict 50-column CSV structure, completed result row presence, distinct ATP player IDs, unique `(tourney_id, match_num)`, exact season start date, fail-closed on bad download/HTML/schema/duplicate IDs. No bookmaker/API access.
- **Immutable local content-hash versions** stored privately under gitignored `data/tml/<year>/<year>-<SHA256>.csv`. Atomic `index.json` metadata update, never silently overwrites earlier snapshots. `UNCHANGED`, `SKIPPED_INTERVAL` or `NEW_SNAPSHOT_REVIEW_REQUIRED` represent source state, **not ML approval**.
- CLI `python -m atp_gate tml-update --year 2026 --root data/tml`. Gitignored `data/` and `reports/` keep raw vendor CSV out of the repo.
- Historical `tml-february-audit` can inspect SHA-qualified file names when filename digest exactly matches bytes, so versioned revisions remain reproducible.
- [Windows opt-in script](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/blob/feat/p1-tml-versioned-updates/scripts/tml_daily_update.ps1) for local owner Task Scheduler (script committed but **not installed on the user's computer**).
- [GitHub Actions metadata-only watch](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/blob/feat/p1-tml-versioned-updates/.github/workflows/tml-source-watch.yml) scheduled **08:21 Asia/Bangkok daily** *only once merged to the default branch*: checks 2024 and UTC current year source snapshots and audits February 2024, uploads only aggregate JSON metadata reports (14-day retention); does NOT upload or commit raw TML CSV, grant rights or train models.
- Documentation `docs/TML_NONCOMMERCIAL_RESEARCH.md` explains source rights, original GitHub vs current official website revisions, local scheduling and manual source quality acceptance.

### TDD and independent evidence
- **RED [Actions #45244996010](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/actions/runs/45244996010):** missing `tml_snapshot` module on initial tests.
- **RED [Actions #45245589889](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/actions/runs/45245589889):** verified SHA-qualified historical audit path rejected before fix.
- **GREEN [Actions #45246197009](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/actions/runs/45246197009)** at head `0fe1c1975242abe9dccf64ab5c3a5bb21edf8ebe`: **4/4 PASS** Ubuntu/Windows Python 3.11/3.12; full Ubuntu Python 3.11 suite **221 passed**.
- CI uses synthetic downloaded bytes and a deterministic local injected fetcher. **A successful real provider HTTPS download and the new scheduled workflow have not yet been verified in a live merged run.**

### Hard limits
Existing partial public GitHub snapshot TML `2024.csv` had 3,076 rows, 340 match rows from twelve February ATP main-tour event candidates, no basic structural anomalies on crosswalk; not full official match draw verification. `tourney_date` is the tournament week/start, **not individual match time**. No independently proven T−60 odds, positive market edge, or fully audited capital lifecycle.

**Always `eligible_for_model_training=0`, `allocation_enabled=false`, `stake=0` in these source monitoring outputs.** To conduct personal research model experiments, create a distinct offline exploratory data track with provenance and no live decision claims. Maintain dataset rights and model validation as independent gates.

**Disposition:** Draft, ready for independent code review, integration order #27 → #28 and explicit merge decision; **not merged**.

## Verified stacked-PR integration — 2026-11-24
- Correct target branch: #27; test merge tree, not a direct merge into `main`.
- [GitHub Actions run #45320971049](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/actions/runs/45320971049): **4/4 PASS** Windows/Ubuntu Python3.11/3.12, Ubuntu Python3.11 **227 passed**.
- `ci.yml` was broadened from PRs targeting only main to `pull_request: {}` so stacked dependency-tree checks are actually executed.
- Still requires independent code review and integration onto main in dependency order. No live model or wagering approval.

## P1.4d — TML candidate source audit for **personal noncommercial** ATP research

**Research context:** Public TML source `https://stats.tennismylife.org/tennis-match-database` permits personal, educational and noncommercial research while disallowing redistribution/commercial use of the raw data. No vendor raw CSV is added to this repository.

### Real public snapshot reconnaissance (NOT a validated model dataset)
Directly inspected `Tennismylife/TML-Database@master:2024.csv` (Git blob SHA-1 `cf513429259b4a15e84e2021206895d9bd4ff772`) on 2026-11-24:
- **3,076** result rows, **50** columns.
- **455** rows under February-start tournaments including Davis Cup; **340** rows in **12** identified ATP tour editions. Four ATP500s (124 matches) and eight ATP250s (216 matches).
- Crosswalk against the pinned ATP official February 2024 event calendar maps all twelve tournament IDs; e.g. Rotterdam 31 and Dallas 27 rows. The snapshot's 340 matching rows passed basic player-ID inequality, round histogram, surface, event-name, start date and format checks **with zero issues in those checks**. This does **not** independently prove full official match-by-match draw correctness.
- `tourney_date` = tournament start/week date, **not the match start**. No T−60 odds or individual match timestamp. TML provider-level `A` does not imply ATP1000; Doha/Los Cabos remain ATP250 by official calendar.

### Implementation
- `docs/registries/tml_2024_feb_source_crosswalk_v1.json` pins 12 official-vs-TML event identities, dates, tiers and expected round histograms; source's GitHub snapshot remains distinct from the official website's updated CSV version.
- `src/atp_gate/tml_historical_audit.py` checks local 2024 CSV SHA256/size, 50-column schema, unique provider match IDs, player identities, round counts, dates and formats. Differing source revision yields anomalies and review, never invented/auto-filled rows.
- CLI `python -m atp_gate tml-february-audit <local 2024.csv> <crosswalk> <official> --out reports/tml_february_2024.json` is read-only for input, explicit output only.
- Synthetic TDD confirms missing/duplicated event rows, mismatched official tier, schema drift, player mismatch, tampered input and no source-overwrite.
- **Always** `eligible_for_model_training=0`, `main_draw_verified=false`, `t60_quote_verified=false`, `allocation_enabled=false`, `stake=0`.

### Verification
- **RED:** [Actions #45243651513](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/actions/runs/45243651513) missing module, before source audit implementation.
- **GREEN:** [Actions #45244342681](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/actions/runs/45244342681) on final head `d91770858a568064de4345dfb96549bf83d3f148`: **4/4 PASS** on Windows/Ubuntu Python 3.11/3.12; Ubuntu 3.11 full suite **208 passed**.

### Follow-up
[Stacked Draft PR #28](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/pull/28) adds versioned opt-in local daily updater. Resolve source-to-official draw and actual individual match timing separately; P2 real walk-forward remains blocked by as-of provenance. No automatic betting allocation, no raw CSV rehosting.

**Disposition:** Draft for review; no automatic merge to `main`.

## New source-to-source reconciliation (2026-11-24)
- Added pinned explicit two-name alias registry `docs/registries/tml_sackmann_2024_player_aliases_v1.json`, design/plan, strict `tml_sackmann_crosscheck.py`, CLI `tml-crosspublication-audit`, synthetic regression suite. Never join TML alphanumeric player IDs to Sackmann numeric IDs, or raw source `match_num` to other provider numbering.
- **Direct source observation (not GitHub test fixture):** TML 2024 GitHub blob `cf513429259b4a15e84e2021206895d9bd4ff772` vs Aneeshers Sackmann 2024 archive blob `c401319bc1dec4633dd2c730aa5a7a7376e176f8`: all 12 February tournament event counts agree, **340/340** same player winner/loser names/round with two explicitly observed aliases, **339/340** exact score text; single difference is Buenos Aires QF retirement `4-6 7-5 RET` vs `4-6 7-5 0-0 RET`. **Shared source lineage likely**, so do not call this independently certified ATP official draw.
- New tests must pass on latest head. TDD RED import failure was observed on test-only commit `f8c88640`, and a further CI test fixture issue was traced to `DictWriter` refusing an intentional absent column **before** the audit function; fixture corrected at `367dfdcc`. **Final latest CI evidence pending**; do not approve or merge on older checks.
- All output flags: official match draw unverified, source independence unverified, no individual start timestamp/T−60, no training certification or real-money allocation. Personal noncommercial research use only.

[GitHub Actions #45322022814](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/actions/runs/45322022814): **4/4 PASS** Windows/Ubuntu Python 3.11/3.12 at head `367dfdcc24f6fbf91755bbbf4ecee0c29291638a`. ## Issue #13 — T−60 quote/fixture receipt PRE-FLIGHT (paper only)

### Scope
Pure retrospective audit helper, **not** a bookmaker integration, execution proof, ROI study or T−60 source acquisition. Test fixtures contain made-up identifiers and odds only.

### What this PR implements
- Exact fixture/quote match and ordered player IDs; same bookmaker and MATCH_WINNER market, original quote ID, HTTPS source URL, decimal prices and overround bounds.
- Time-aware `published_at <= observed_at <= retrieved_at <= as_of` and max-30-minute quote age, at least 60 minutes before confirmed **scheduled** start, independently checked against **retrospective actual first serve** when available. Actual start must **not** enter prematch model features.
- Suspended/revoked markets, future/stale quote, unknown retirement/void settlement, unconfirmed start and missing actual-start evidence are rejected.
- Optional independently managed receipt report ID→SHA matching. Even if exact, output is only `QUOTE_REVIEW_ONLY` with `t60_execution_verified=false` and `allocation_enabled=false`; a digest is **not** provider-signed proof of offered price.
- `NO_TRUSTED_T60_SOURCE` status when mechanical inputs are plausible but receipt independently unverified; safe default abstention to real-money actions.
- Synthetic-only `tests/test_quote_receipt.py`, [design/implementation plan](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/tree/feat/p3-t60-quote-receipt-audit/docs/superpowers), and [P3 preflight reference](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/blob/feat/p3-t60-quote-receipt-audit/docs/P3_T60_RECEIPT_AUDIT.md).

### Limitations / real dependencies
No licensed real quote stream/receipt, confirmed live odds availability, source rights, official player/draw completeness or market edge. Historical opening/closing odds cannot be considered executable T−60 snapshots. No actual bet or bankroll integration; `allocation_enabled=false`, `stake=0`.

## Issue #12 — preparatory matched-fold scorer (NOT model training)

**Scope:** small, purely offline research evaluator for independently supplied test-fold probabilities; no data source authorization or model fit. It never says a strategy is profitable, never generates trusted model validation, and has no betting execution.

### Code
- `src/atp_gate/fold_scoring.py`: strict 3+ expanding chronological training cutoffs and non-overlapping, non-leaking calibration/test date windows; each holdout row requires stable match/event ID, actual outcome, same market/Elo/XGB probability columns, tier and surface; duplicates, unsupported tiers, missing values and nonfinite probabilities rejected.
- Computes proper **Brier and log loss** per fold and for exactly the same matched aggregate rows, plus paired differences in XGB/Elo log loss against the historical no-vig market comparator.
- Deterministic bootstrap of tournament-edition **event clusters within each fold** for descriptive paired-difference intervals; refuses to attach a CI when effective cluster support is inadequate. This is not a multiple-hypothesis correction, an externally valid confidence guarantee, or proof of executable market edge.
- Synthetic-only tests and [methodology documentation](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/blob/feat/p2-walkforward-score-audit/docs/P2_MATCHED_FOLD_SCORING.md).

### TDD and CI
- **RED:** [Actions #45238809703](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/actions/runs/45238809703) on test-only branch commit `33f2eae`: expected import failure for `atp_gate.fold_scoring`.
- **GREEN:** [Actions #45239075808](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/actions/runs/45239075808) on head `0223ee9132dfae071e0a1a2b99bb7e1b7066fb69`: **4/4 PASS** Windows/Ubuntu Python 3.11/3.12; Linux 3.11 full suite **211 passed**.

### Explicit blockers
The existing single-split 2026 holdout n=121 had market logloss 0.557579 vs Elo 0.598358 vs calibrated XGB 0.630966. This PR does not retrain XGB or alter that result. Real multi-season predictions, source rights, main-draw evidence, as-of feature parity, timestamped T−60 market quotes and locked validation reports remain unavailable. `market_edge_verified=false`, `allocation_enabled=false`, `stake=0`.

**Status:** 4/4 CI verified, Draft PR for independent code review and user merge choice. Issue #12 remains open until actual licensed multi-season walk-forward is executed.

## P1.4d — strict source-intake for user's **personal noncommercial** ATP research
This project owner explicitly does not intend commercial use. **A commercial-use grant must not be required** for personal research when a source's actual terms permit that purpose. Public availability alone is not a blanket AI-training license, and raw source redistribution remains excluded unless granted.

### Implemented
- Input SHA-256 and byte-size validation; pinned source-inventory digest; allowlisted manifest fields, source URL and UTC retrieval metadata, official event subset, immutable external review report ID/hash, explicit data-source and correction scope.
- `audit_source_intake(... intended_use="PERSONAL_NONCOMMERCIAL_RESEARCH")` now treats a credible independent permission report as compatible with `commercial_use_allowed=false` *if the source actually permits personal noncommercial ML use* and `ai_training_allowed=true`. `intended_use="COMMERCIAL"` still requires commercial permission and cannot be accidentally promoted.
- Local CLI cannot self-authorize a provider or an archived HTML event index; full official draw identity and genuine match outcomes remain a separate audit. Regardless of rights-review result, this intake module always produces `eligible_for_model_training=0`, `allocation_enabled=false`, `stake=0` until distinct validation gates.
- Original Valuebetennis file remains pinned and unchanged, no invented February 2024 rows. No raw provider CSV committed.
- TML public noncommercial alternative source candidate covered in [Draft PR #27](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/pull/27); versioned updating in stacked [Draft PR #28](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/pull/28).

### Verified CI
**[GitHub Actions #45243769523](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/actions/runs/45243769523)**: **4/4 PASS** Windows/Ubuntu Python3.11/3.12, **215 tests passed** Ubuntu 3.11. Current head `394d70d23e04442ec819d5ca9ae98a64c15b70ec`.

### Caveats
Independent rights receipt identity and manifest hash are not legal proof; separate source terms and actual data origin must be verified. The project may run experimental offline historical skill research using appropriately permitted public records, but live/betting model release and ROI claims are still blocked by match timing, official draw, quote and calibration evidence.

**Status:** Draft for independent review, no auto merge or production model release.

open_pull_requests.head: feat/p0-cross-month-carry
open_pull_requests.body:
## Issue #21 — cross-month unsettled position carry (paper only)

**Stacked Draft PR:** this branch starts from code PR #20 and currently includes #20's unmerged changes when compared to `main`. **Merge #20 first**, review this PR against its base, then review this change separately. No auto-merge.

### Previous failure and implemented design
- Before this patch, `close_month` refused any open position, creating a reporting deadlock for a match reserved at 23:50 Bangkok on January 31 and settled after midnight February 1.
- Adopt a conservative **cost-basis carry** (no mark-to-market or forecasted P&L): outstanding stake is an asset at original stake until real settlement. `MonthlyReport.carried_open_exposure` reports its amount. At month close, `net = free_cash + protected_cash + open_exposure - 1000`; next paper month keeps the open positions and journal, and starts with available cash `1000 - carried_open_exposure`, reflecting separately counted replenishment.
- A verified WIN/LOSS/VOID outcome is recorded in the **month of actual settlement**, with original timestamp, odds and stake; do not backdate, infer outcomes, or count an unsettled position as realized loss.
- Original `seen_match_ids` is reset at month close but duplicate match reservation remains blocked by the preserved journal. Weekly loss carry semantics from #20 are maintained.
- Existing ledger regression that previously required rejection on open positions is updated to require cost-basis carry instead. Added parametric WIN/LOSS/VOID, multiple positions, year/week boundaries, corrupted exposure and retroactive settlement tests.
- Docs clarify that a cost-basis equity statement is not external broker accounting, that journal authenticity is not cryptographically established, and no cash flows are connected to money APIs.

### TDD evidence
- **RED:** [GitHub Actions run #45236706232](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/actions/runs/45236706232) failed as expected at the old `ValueError("open positions must settle before month rollover")`, prior to implementation.
- **GREEN:** [GitHub Actions run #45237310723](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/actions/runs/45237310723) — **4/4 PASS** Windows/Ubuntu, Python 3.11/3.12 for head `10624e5e6941b06796c64f1c5754df2d1f0ab052`. All matrix jobs include full `python -m pytest -q` and smoke checks.

### Still blocked
- Rights for legacy February 2024 HTML results; official main-draw/participant completeness; multi-season XGB calibration vs market; true T−60 quotes; any trade execution or claim of reliable profit.
- No financial-policy rule constants changed. PR remains Draft for independent code review and user decision; no merge performed in this task.

## Verified stacked-PR integration — 2026-11-24
- Correct target branch: #20; test merge tree, not a direct merge into `main`.
- [GitHub Actions run #45320967514](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/actions/runs/45320967514): **4/4 PASS** Windows/Ubuntu Python3.11/3.12, Ubuntu Python3.11 **221 passed**.
- `ci.yml` was broadened from PRs targeting only main to `pull_request: {}` so stacked dependency-tree checks are actually executed.
- Still requires independent code review and integration onto main in dependency order. No live model or wagering approval.

## Purpose — Issue #18
Implement the accepted **paper-only** period-integrity design from merged [PR #19](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/pull/19). Do not interpret this patch as an actual value-betting model or real-money readiness.

## Changes
- New `period_risk.py`: explicit Bangkok day and Monday-start week, strict replay of timestamped `RESERVE`, `SETTLE_WIN/LOSS/VOID`, and `PROFIT_LOCK` entries, with loss charged to original reserved stake in the settlement week.
- `RiskState` gains optional `selection_day` and `loss_week_start`. Legacy decoding allowed, but `policy.evaluate` **ABSTAINs** with `RISK_PERIOD_UNVERIFIED` when a marker is absent or stale.
- `paper_ledger.reconcile_periods` checks historical counters, journal, reserved identities, current positions and open exposure against replay before stamping the current period.
- `record_selection` and `settle_selection` reconcile before operations; `close_month` preserves the journal and carries same-week gross losses into a new month instead of clearing them.
- `tests/test_period_risk.py`, additional `tests/test_gate.py` checks and paper-ledger operations/caveats documented in `docs/PAPER_LEDGER_PERIODS.md`. Implementation plan retained under `docs/superpowers/plans/`.

## Verifiable TDD & CI
- **RED:** [Actions #45233399071](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/actions/runs/45233399071): Python test collection failed on missing `paper_ledger.reconcile_periods` as intended before production implementation.
- **GREEN:** [Actions #45234456691](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/actions/runs/45234456691): **all 4/4 jobs succeeded** on Ubuntu/Windows Python 3.11/3.12; Linux Python 3.11 reports **214 passed** in the full suite. Includes safe-default gate and synthetic historical audit CI steps.
- Last verified PR head: `8a745dd17032656a7b8f9055da42f65b3e52d4de`, compared against `main` merge `d64fdb23a668bde5168d5dd61809edc16ecd3c29`.

## Remaining review boundaries
- **Cross-month unresolved position accounting is a separate problem:** an open selection cannot yet be settled across Bangkok-local reporting month end without a broader month-close treatment. This patch intentionally **fails closed** rather than backdating or misattributing a loss. Tracked explicitly in [Issue #21](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/issues/21).
- Period stamps are not cryptographic proof; journal provenance and financial balance authenticity must be supplied by a trusted caller. Cannot reconstruct lost legacy journal history.
- This does not unlock historical source rights (P1.4d #17), multi-season model edge (P2 #12), T−60 quotes or real money (P3 #13). Policy parameters `MIN_EV=0.02`, 0.25 fractional Kelly, unit limits, floors and profit lock have not been tuned or changed.

**Disposition:** code and full CI verified, but **Draft PR remains open for review and user merge decision**. No automatic merge to `main`.

issues.title: P2 offline noncommercial research — pre-tournament Elo baseline from versioned TML ATP CSVs
issues.body:
## User goal
Use openly published ATP historical records for **private noncommercial ML research** without waiting for commercial rights or historical T−60 odds; evaluate genuinely out-of-time skill predictors, not betting execution.

## Dependencies
- TML local source audit [Draft #27](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/pull/27) and immutable source versions [Draft #28](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/pull/28), with appropriate noncommercial source terms and no raw redistribution.
- P2 [#12](https://github.com/24021368-DucAnh/atp-forecasting-research/issues/12) scoring protocol; P1.4d official draw identity still unverified for full source certification.
- No P3 T−60 quotes for this offline skill-baseline experiment; ROI/stake/CLV excluded.

## Safe, precise experimental contract
1. Read original local TML yearly CSV snapshots (e.g. 2021–2026) pinned by SHA256, with explicit source-use attribution. Never silently merge Valuebetennis or overwrite source bytes.
2. `tourney_date` gives **tournament week/start date only**. Build a **pre-tournament / lagged-availability** feature timeline, not an individual match timestamp. An event's match outcomes/statistics may update ratings only after its **verified end date**, or a documented conservative event embargo when verified end unavailable; never allow a final-round result into an earlier round's prematch features. No event-local leakage.
3. Determine stable ATP player identity by `winner_id`/`loser_id`; enforce one source match per `(tourney_id,match_num)`, exclude invalid walkovers/retirements per explicit research protocol. Distinguish fixture known at forecast time from the *retrospective set of matchups that eventually occurred*; no real-time availability claim.
4. Champion baselines: overall Elo, shrinkage surface Elo; optional game-margin weighted Elo only after scoreline parsing, retirement validity and controlled ablations. Begin with proper probability calibration and same-match chronological holdouts; no expensive neural models before baseline passes.
5. Pre-register at least 3 disjoint chronological holdouts and separate calibration fit, report log-loss/Brier/coverage/CI as a **historical skill experiment**, without odds/financial metrics. Publish negative results.
6. Output explicitly `HISTORICAL_SKILL_RESEARCH_ONLY`; no trustworthy match-level T−60 report, no live allocation, `stake=0`. Any exploratory training eligibility must be a **separate** narrowly scoped capability from production certification; never relax `policy.evaluate` or current risk-gate restrictions.
7. Tests: same-event leakage, future schedule/result leakage, identity swaps, duplicate matches, schema/sha drift, extreme sparse surface history, missing player IDs, three temporal folds, joint ensemble optimism. RED→GREEN→4/4 CI→Draft PR→review.

## Non-goals
No inferred actual individual start time, no sportsbook price snapshots, no automated bet selection, no profit guarantee, no raw public redistribution, no model certification before official draw check.

## Definition of done
A reproducible experiment with immutable source manifests and out-of-time forecast tables on actual permitted local data; conclusions tied to observed scores and uncertainty, **not** to stale market ROI or fabricated quote timestamps. Keep issue separate from P1.4d certification and P3 market readiness.

issues.title: P0 integrity follow-up — independently replay paper cash, exact WIN payouts and period transfers
issues.body:
## Root cause / safety review (2026-11-24)
PR #20's `replay_journal` correctly detects duplicate reservations, multiple settlements, loss and void payout shape, and reconciles current positions/period counts. However, **it does not certify total cash balances**, because `JournalEvent.RESERVE` stores reserved stake but not original offered odds, and `JournalEvent.SETTLE_WIN` currently checks only that payout is **greater than stake**, not that payout equals `stake * odds` captured at accepted reserve time. The `PaperBook` journal also lacks explicit month-close/top-up events, so `free_cash`, `protected_cash`, `annual_negative_month_loss` and external funding cannot be independently replayed end-to-end from retained journal alone.

**Do not claim journal is externally tamper-proof or full cash accounting verified merely because current 214 tests pass.** This is a separate high-priority requirement before certifying a paper-risk track record or relying on simulated ROI.

## Required design
- Capture exact decimal odds, immutable IDs and accepted offer price with the reserve evidence (or a content-hashed immutable position archive), and verify settlement payout exactly against accepted odds, including rounding policy and retirement/void rules.
- Record month-close cost-basis carry, external top-up, profit protection transfer as auditable journal events; preserve original timestamps and period IDs.
- Independently derive/reconcile cash, protected funds, realized gross losses, open exposure and year/month totals from authenticated and complete events.
- Reject forged `SETTLE_WIN.amount`, rewritten `odds`, modified balances, duplicate top-ups, reordered events, negative/NaN values, mismatched month close and future event times.
- TDD, 4/4 Actions, independent review, PR distinct from #20 and #22. Keep stake policy unchanged and paper-only.

## Dependencies
PR #20 period replay, stacked PR #22 cross-month cost-basis carry. Source licensing #17/P2/P3 remain separate blockers. Zero training and live allocation until independent evidence exists.

**Status:** scope documented; no claim of code implementation yet.

issues.title: P0 follow-up — cross-month unsettled paper positions and month-close accounting
issues.body:
## Problem
During Issue #18 review, `close_month(book, next_month)` was confirmed to reject books with open positions, while `settle_selection(book, ... at)` in the period-integrity patch rejects settlement timestamp belonging to a different Bangkok-local month from `RiskState.month`. That is **fail-closed** and prevents wrong-month attribution, but an event reserved at 23:50 Bangkok and settled at 00:10 after month end cannot complete its accounting lifecycle using the current public API. Do not backdate or fabricate settlements.

## Scope / requirements
- Independently specify correct month-close treatment for live-at-boundary hypothetical positions: market exposure, unsettled cash, settlement-month realization, prior-month reporting, year loss budgets, and `needed_topup` without double counting.
- Decide whether carry forward and deferred close or an accrual/settlement distinction is appropriate; record explicit controls and guarantees.
- Preserve immutable event time, event/month identity, profit-lock rules, paper-only restriction, licensing/model and T−60 gates.
- Tests for year/month/week boundary (including Bangkok midnight different from UTC), reserve in one month and settlement win/loss/void in following month, multiple unsettled events, no retroactive edits, end-of-year annual losses, accounting invariant and journal replay after rollover.
- TDD RED/GREEN, 4/4 Windows/Ubuntu CI, reviewed PR independent of Issue #18.

## Non-goals
No live money execution or claims of sustained profit; no change to model or stake-policy thresholds.

**Dependency:** Issue #18 / code PR #20 explicitly documents this limitation. Keep it separate to avoid changing monthly finance semantics in a daily/weekly counter repair.

issues.title: P0 risk ledger — audit daily/weekly counter rollover and journal reconciliation (paper-only)
issues.body:
## Objective
Make daily and weekly limits in the **paper-only** risk ledger deterministic and auditable from dated journal activity, including month/day/week boundary transitions, before evaluating any hypothetical selection strategy. Do **not** enable real-money allocation.

## Evidence on `main` (2026-11-24)
- `src/atp_gate/paper_ledger.py::record_selection` increments `RiskState.selections_today` by one.
- `settle_selection` increments `week_loss_realized` on a loss.
- The only in-repo reset of these counters is `close_month`, which resets both to zero when advancing **the month**.
- `RiskState` has `month` but no explicit daily/weekly period key; `JournalEvent` records `at` timestamps. The existing tests assert daily/weekly caps but do not test calendar rollover or reconstruction. If an external controller manages resets, its semantics and verification are not in this repo.
- `policy.py` also stores `month_loss_realized` but its named monthly stop semantics should be explicitly specified; avoid assuming gross realized losses equal net monthly P&L.

## Risks
- A selection limit named 'per day' may remain exhausted until month end unless an external component resets it.
- A loss limit named 'per week' may remain exhausted until month end; arbitrary external resets might unintentionally erase evidence.
- Across Asia/Bangkok midnight or Monday boundaries, stale state can generate wrong `ABSTAIN` or inconsistent exposure.
- Recomputing from mutable client-supplied counters is not sufficient evidence of safety.

## Proposed design (needs Superpowers review before implementation)
1. Specify Bangkok-local day and Monday–Sunday week identifiers. Define when each amount accrues: selections by accepted reservation time, realized gross losses by settlement time; open exposure persists across period boundaries.
2. Reconcile persisted `RiskState` with an append-only, timestamped journal; **fail closed** on missing events, timestamp inversion, duplicate IDs, stale period keys or inconsistent derived counts.
3. Add pure period transition/reconciliation functions; no speculative reset of unsettled orders, protected principal or annual loss budgets.
4. Test 23:59→00:00 Asia/Bangkok, Sunday→Monday, month/year boundary, pending settlement crossing periods, duplicate reserve/settle, nonmonotonic event time, and property-based balance invariants if appropriate.
5. Run RED→GREEN→full pytest→Windows/Ubuntu Python3.11/3.12 CI, code review, draft PR. Do not change policy thresholds (`MIN_EV=0.02`, Kelly 0.25, `MAX_STAKE=10`) in the same change.

## Acceptance
Daily/weekly counters are derived reproducibly from dated evidence, or the paper gate abstains on stale/unverifiable state. No model data or live execution changes. Link P3 #13 for later policy optimization; P1.4 #11/#17 and P2 #12 remain independent blockers.

**Research context:** [Uhrín et al. 2021](https://doi.org/10.1093/imaman/dpaa029), [Busseti et al. 2016](https://doi.org/10.3905/joi.2016.25.3.118): risk constraints matter but provide no profit guarantee under model misspecification.

issues.title: P1.4d — Obtain licensed February 2024 match-level results and official draw completeness
issues.body:
## Objective

Acquire **lawfully reusable historical, match-level ATP 2024 results** (starting with the 12 confirmed missing February tournament editions) and establish independent draw/identity completeness **without fabricating outcomes**. Depends on Issue #11, user real source audits P1.4a/P1.4b and PR #16 metadata-only archive ID crosswalk.

## Proven facts

- Pinned 2024 Valuebetennis CSV: 79,910 raw rows / 3,409 provisional ATP top-tour rows; **zero February 2024 raw dated rows**, 0 malformed dates, SHA256 `09437d8208c937d9efb82af232edf6c6f8520be7ec2d6773dde71886b79c68ef`.
- Official ATP calendar: 12 February ATP tour events, 8 ATP250 and 4 ATP500; all absent from source inventory.
- Legacy Valuebetennis 2.0 HTML tournament index lists 12 event **IDs**, but **no match results/licensing guarantee**; modern CC BY 4.0 grant is explicitly for downloaded annual CSVs. https://www.valuebetennis.com/tournaments/2024/02/archive.htm and https://www.valuebetennis.com/en/donnees.htm .
- Provider's modern guide distinguishes live-imported published CSV from retrospective imports not necessarily reliable/published. https://www.valuebetennis.com/en/guide/base-de-donnees-tennis.htm .
- No existing source is permitted to enter the model on this evidence alone.

## Research and implementation tasks

- [ ] Contact Valuebetennis support to request 2024 Feb historical results as a separately licensed machine-readable export; ask whether old HTML match pages are covered by any reuse licence (especially AI training/commercial products), response date, provenance/source ID scope, import process and reliability. **Do not assume approval or scrape without rights.**
- [ ] If denied/unavailable, evaluate alternate providers on rights for planned usage (not just public availability): Jeff Sackmann CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 noncommercial/ShareAlike; Tennis-Data.co.uk independent usage terms; official ATP Data Innovations terms; explicitly documented third-party licensed API if budget supports.
- [ ] Inspect real local sample CSV match schema and licensing evidence; do not commit raw third-party rows until distribution rights are verified.
- [ ] Create immutable correction-source manifest: source URL/contract, attribution, permitted uses, download UTC, byte SHA256, season/date window, record count, edit history and who reviewed.
- [ ] Link each match to official per-edition draw and individual participant IDs. Verify outcome, score, round, qualifying/walkover/retirement status and prevent duplicate or changed outcomes.
- [ ] Publish an **event × official round × source** completeness matrix, verified using official archival results for the 12 February events (first focus: Rotterdam ATP500 and Dallas ATP250), with exact absent/unmatched counts.
- [ ] TDD red/green for source permission denied, ID collisions, date/year mismatch, round-code uncertainty, duplicate and conflicting outcomes, incomplete event. CI full Windows/Ubuntu Python3.11/3.12 green.
- [ ] Preserve the original 2024 Valuebetennis snapshot; stage corrected data separately, and quarantine incomplete events/years. Never synthetically impute results or label an opening/closing price T−60.

## Acceptance and safety

If no legally usable match-level data with official draw/identity confirmation exists, **stop at `NO_AUTHORIZED_HISTORICAL_REPAIR_SOURCE`** and continue only on a separately evidenced complete subset. Complete 2024 historical season, P2 multi-year walk-forward, market edge and any live allocation remain unapproved: `eligible_for_model_training=0`, `allocation_enabled=false`, `stake=0`.

Do not declare match reconstruction complete based solely on the legacy 12-event ID index (PR #16).

issues.title: P3 — Timestamped T−60 price/source evidence and paper-only decision audit
issues.body:
## Objective
Research whether trustworthy, licensed and independently timestamped prematch odds plus verified actual/scheduled first serve are available. Do not enable execution or live staking without evidence.

## Hard requirements
- [ ] Inventory vendors/APIs, licence/redistribution terms, quote update timestamps, market/selection identifiers, odds freshness, cancellations, postponed matches, all-source SHA256 or API audit metadata.
- [ ] Match precisely to independent official ATP singles draw/verified player IDs, actual start, scheduled start and timezones. Define T−60 cutoff and delayed/early suspension behavior.
- [ ] Tests for quote after cutoff, stale odds, unmatched identity, abnormal odds, suspended market, postponed start, no actual start timestamp, duplicate quotes and revoked price.
- [ ] A source lacking trustworthy T−60 snapshots is **ineligible**; neither opening nor closing odds may be relabeled T−60.
- [ ] Only when P2 demonstrates independent robust out-of-time improvement, design monitored **paper-only** forecasting decisions: frozen predictions, odds, lower-bound expected value, abstention reasons, simulated stake=0.
- [ ] CLV, selective coverage, outcomes and uncertainty over independent paper observations, pre-registered thresholds and monitoring; no automatic real-money actions or Kelly claims.

## Exit
Either (a) independently reproducible quote-time data with paper-only audit, or (b) clear `NO_TRUSTED_T60_SOURCE` and `ABSTAIN` outcome. Live allocation remains disabled.

issues.title: P2 — Pre-registered multi-season walk-forward Elo/XGB versus matched market
issues.body:
## Objective
After #7 and P1.4 data completeness/identity/permissions are accepted, build multi-season, strictly point-in-time ATP singles forecasting evaluation. No claims of edge from existing 2026 partial holdout.

## Required design
- [ ] At least three out-of-time, chronologically non-overlapping evaluation folds across multiple seasons, with train/calibration/test separated by dates and no same-day leakage; training-serving feature parity.
- [ ] Document feature availability at the forecast cutoff and correct player ID, surface/history timeline; exclude provider-derived post-match information, retirements and invalid labels under pre-registered rules.
- [ ] Frozen baselines: rank/elo, raw XGB, calibrated XGB, market de-vig odds. Compare exactly the same match IDs/tiers in each fold; no silent sample differences or imputation.
- [ ] Log loss, Brier, calibration, selective coverage/error tradeoff, year/tier/surface results, sample sizes and 95% paired/clustered uncertainty intervals.
- [ ] Audit hyperparameter and calibration selection using only earlier data, then evaluate untouched later holds. Report whether any improvement over market persists across folds.
- [ ] Reproducible JSON evidence: input SHA256, dependency versions, deterministic seeds, code fingerprint, fold dates and audit reasons.
- [ ] Do not conflate historical opening/closing odds (unknown quote time) with tradable T−60 price; score as historical reference only.
- [ ] 4/4 CI green with leakage and paired-comparison tests; independent negative-result reporting.

## Existing negative baseline
On partial 2026 holdout n=121: historical no-vig market log-loss 0.557579, Elo 0.598358, calibrated XGB 0.630966. No demonstrated predictive or market advantage. No training from unverified Valuebetennis source.

## Exit
Auditable out-of-time report with robust uncertainty and no hidden leakage or invented market edge; live eligibility false, allocation disabled, stake zero.

issues.title: P1.4 — Repair source event/round gaps and certify main-draw evidence
issues.body:
## Objective
Reconcile lawful historical data with official ATP/Grand Slam tournament-edition schedules and bracket results **before any 2022–2026 Valuebetennis row enters the historical model**. Upstream: #7 and PR #10.

## Why
2024 source is non-randomly incomplete: Rotterdam ATP500 absent; Australian Open source ends Jan23 but the official final was Jan28; Indian Wells has 47 provisional matches vs 131 in 2023; other late-stage gaps. The current source can have severe selection bias. Cross-UTC-year provider IDs must map to official editions, not calendar-year guesswork.

## Work packages / gates
- [ ] Source permission and provenance verified for every independent correction file; record download UTC, SHA256 and licence, never commit raw third-party CSVs.
- [ ] Explicit edition key and verified tier sources for all target ATP500/M1000/Grand Slam events and ATP250 history; unresolved event identifiers excluded, not guessed.
- [ ] Match-level independent official main-draw reconciliation by tournament+round+participant ID; verify player aliases, singles only, retirements/walkovers and amended results; preserve source coverage exclusions.
- [ ] Detect missing qualifying/main-draw rounds and cross-UTC-year IDs with versioned snapshots. Do not impute missing match results.
- [ ] Publish completeness matrix per official edition, tier, year, surface and round, with source evidence URLs, source row counts and unmatched percentage.
- [ ] TDD for cross-year, qualifier exclusion, duplicate match, partial draw and player ID collisions; CI Windows/Ubuntu Python3.11/3.12.
- [ ] Only independently verified **research** rows may be considered for future walk-forward; never claim T−60 odds or market tradability.

## Exit
No unresolved or incomplete matches silently enter training/test; source rights documented, versioned identity/tier/draw mapping covers the selected evaluation subset; rest explicitly excluded. Allocation/trade gate stays disabled.

issues.title: P1.3: verify ATP tournament-season tier registry and main-draw eligibility
issues.body:
## Goal

Create an evidence-backed, versioned provider-tournament-season mapping and verified main-draw filter for Valuebetennis data **before** allowing any new-source row into the ATP model. Depends on PR #6 plus an actual provider source-file sample.

## Why this blocks training

Valuebetennis exports `categorie=Main tour` without distinguishing ATP 250 vs ATP 500. Its `tour` field is the draw-round number 0..12, **not the ATP/WTA circuit**. It includes ITF/Challenger categories, and the provider's opening and closing odds cannot establish prices at T−60. If we guess a mapping, the user-defined prediction-tier evaluation becomes invalid.

## Required evidence and process

- [ ] Inspect actual Valuebetennis CSVs from the provider (e.g. 2022–2026), record exact file hashes, downloaded-at UTC, encoding, header and sample shapes without pushing licensed data to Git.
- [ ] Build **independent**, per-year tournament ID → ATP tier mapping (ATP_250 / ATP_500 / MASTERS_1000 / GRAND_SLAM), with tournament name, season, official evidence URL and review date. All unresolved or contradictory entries are excluded and counted.
- [ ] Verify singles **main draw** and map provider numeric round using authoritative per-tournament draw evidence, not a guessed global `tour >= N` threshold.
- [ ] Validate stable player ID scope across seasons; preserve aliases, identify ID reuse and name collision without automatic name-based joins.
- [ ] Enforce single matching source ID per match; cross-season duplication checks and no post-outcome feature leakage.
- [ ] Add test-first explicit include/exclude cases for ATP250 history only, ATP500/Masters/Slams evaluation, WTA/ITF/Challenger/qualifier excluded, unidentified tournaments fail-closed.
- [ ] Add machine-readable acceptance profile by year/tier/surface; record unverified/unmapped/excluded fractions and coverage rather than pretending full season completeness.
- [ ] Keep source attribution: Valuebetennis, Tennis results and odds since 2021, https://www.valuebetennis.com/en/donnees.htm (provider states CC BY 4.0).
- [ ] Only after review and 4/4 GitHub CI pass, permit a **separate historical research adapter** from verified IDs into the modeling path.

## Acceptance

- Real provider CSV source compatibility tested, not only synthetic fixtures.
- Zero ambiguous categories included in model eligibility.
- Any missing official tier mapping or uncertain draw membership leads to **exclude/abstain**, never inferred tier.
- No real money allocation; `allocation_enabled=false`, `stake=0`, `t60_quote_verified=false`.
- No claim of independent predictive or market edge without out-of-time evaluation and actual first-serve/timestamped odds snapshots.

issues.title: P1 roadmap: provenance-verified multi-season ATP data and walk-forward evaluation
issues.body:
## Goal

Extend the ATP historical research pipeline to lawful, provenance-verified multi-season observations and implement pre-registered chronological walk-forward evaluation. This is **research only**, not a live betting or allocation task.

## Existing evidence and motivation

- V0.2.1 ATP 2026 snapshot: 1,016 rows, 984 completed, 475 history-eligible, 121 target-tier holdout matches (2026-04-14–2026-05-03).
- Holdout log loss: historical market benchmark 0.557579; Elo 0.598358; calibrated XGBoost 0.630966. This is a narrow partial-season finding, not proof of persistent market edge.
- Historic odds are day-only and cannot certify a T−60 price.
- Source player names are not verified stable IDs, and four serve/return inputs are unavailable.

## Work packages (separate PRs, no changes to `main` until checks pass)

- [ ] **P1.1 Source rights and schema audit:** review permitted use, origin, seasonal coverage, exact source checksums, retirements/walkovers, duplicate keys, variable fields, naming conventions, missing odds/ranks; never commit restricted datasets.
- [ ] **P1.2 Stable player identity:** independent alias/ID mapping, collision checks, historical season handoffs, fail-closed unresolved pairs; require day-only temporal provenance.
- [ ] **P1.3 Strict time walk-forward:** multiple non-overlapping train/calibration/test windows by date/year; no tuning on final holdout; strict train/inference feature schema parity and no post-outcome features.
- [ ] **P1.4 Independent evaluation:** Elo, calibrated XGBoost and de-vig market odds on exactly matching rows, actual tier/surface/year counts, loss metrics and uncertainty intervals.
- [ ] **P1.5 Scientific validity audit:** report missingness, selection bias, multiple-comparison handling, calibration and drift, source-date ambiguity, leave-one-season-out sensitivity.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Multiple independent out-of-time holdout windows, not a single 2026 spring segment.
- [ ] Automated tests demonstrate no same-day leakage and no post-match feature access.
- [ ] Every report records source hash, dependency versions, source-code fingerprint and split boundaries; saved results are reproducible.
- [ ] Evaluation distinguishes observed tier counts from configured target tier list.
- [ ] Every report remains `HISTORICAL_RESEARCH_ONLY`, `allocation_enabled=false`, `stake=0`, `validation_report_trusted=false`.
- [ ] **No claims of tradable expected value** without authentic pre-match quote timestamp, actual start time, retirement rules and independent validation.

## Dependencies

Finish and merge validated P0 reproducibility PRs before structural model changes. Avoid connecting the historical research model to the strict V0.1 live gate.

note: PR head ancestry is not equivalent to review or merge; diverged PR changes may have been reimplemented or integrated by different commits; compare diffs. Original issue and PR comments and full CI logs remain available in repository; this is a metadata snapshot, not a copy of all discussion.
